name: PyTorch DevContainer — NGC 25.08
initializeCommand:
bash -lc '\
    set -e; \
    REPO=${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}; \
    mkdir -p .devcontainer; \
    if [ -f "$HOME/.env" ]; then cp "$HOME/.env" .devcontainer/.env.devcontainer; else : > .devcontainer/.env.devcontainer; fi; \
    create_host_path() { \
      mkdir -p "$1" 2>/dev/null && return 0; \
      if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
        sudo -n mkdir -p "$1" 2>/dev/null && return 0; \
      fi; \
      echo "[devcontainer] Warning: could not create $1 (check permissions)" >&2; \
    }; \
    for path in \
      /data/caches/torch \
      /data/caches/huggingface \
      /data/projects/${REPO}/data \
      /data/projects/${REPO}/datasets; do \
      create_host_path "$path"; \
    done \
  '
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'chmod +x /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}/dev.sh && mkdir -p src tests misc examples docs datasets && uv venv --system-site-packages && uv sync --extra dev'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -d .venv ]; then . .venv/bin/activate; fi; nohup jupyter lab --ServerApp.token="" --ServerApp.password="" --ip=0.0.0.0 --port=8888 --no-browser > /home/vscode/.jupyter.log 2>&1 & nohup tensorboard --logdir /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}/runs --host=0.0.0.0 --port=6006 > /home/vscode/.tensorboard.log 2>&1 & sleep 1'
